import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    ptr = 0
    n = data[ptr]
    ptr += 1
    for student_idx in range(1, n + 1):
        c = data[ptr]
        ptr += 1
        course_avgs = []
        for _ in range(c):
            a = data[ptr]
            ptr += 1
            scores = data[ptr:ptr + a]
            ptr += a
            avg = sum(scores) / a
            course_avgs.append(avg)
        print(f"Student {student_idx}:")
        for i, avg in enumerate(course_avgs, start=1):
            print(f"Course {i} Average: {avg:.2f}")
        overall = sum(course_avgs) / c if c > 0 else 0.0
        print(f"Overall Average: {overall:.2f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
